name: Mexico
overview:
“Viva Mexico!”, I scream as a military parade rolls through the centre of Mexico City. By dumb luck, we landed for Mexican Independence Day, which is one way to make a first impression.

Mexico is one of those countries whose popular image is simultaneously accurate and wildly incomplete. Yes, there are tacos, pyramids and Caribbean waters. There is also a 20-million-plus megacity that stays out late, ancient civilisations layered on top of each other, and a social warmth that repeatedly showed up when we needed help.

Our six days were geographically inefficient but emotionally efficient: Mexico City, Teotihuacan, Chichen Itza and Bacalar. Fallen empires, sunken waters, rising city.
